name: comp-366
title: Ellipsis Dropdown Menu
blurb: Dropdown menu triggered by ellipsis icon.
description: A circular ghost button with an ellipsis icon triggering a dropdown menu with simple text options.
use_when: Secondary actions in tables, cards, or toolbars that should stay compact.
avoid_when: Primary actions or when menu space is limited.
a11y: Button has aria-label; menu items are keyboard navigable.
